claimant_lives_in_uk.description: Whether the claimant lives in the UK.

children.description: A list of children the claimant is claiming for.

lives_with_claimant.description: Whether the child lives with the claimant.

in_approved_education.description: Whether the child is in approved education or training (e.g. A-levels, GCSEs, NVQ up to level 3). Only relevant for children aged 16-19.

in_extension_period.description: Whether the child (aged 16 or 17) has left education and registered with a government-sponsored careers service or the armed forces (qualifying for a 20-week extension).

upkeep_per_week.description: The amount in £ per week the claimant contributes towards the child's upkeep (food, clothes, pocket money, etc.). Only relevant if the child does not live with the claimant.

another_claimant_has_priority.description: Whether another person who also lives with the child has priority for claiming Child Benefit.

another_claimant_lives_with_child.description: Whether someone who lives with the child is already claiming Child Benefit for them.

care_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in local authority care.

care_home_24h_per_week.description: Whether the child spends at least 24 hours per week at home while in local authority care.

hospital_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in hospital or residential accommodation.

claimant_spends_on_child.description: Whether the claimant regularly spends money on the child (e.g. food, clothes, books) while the child is in hospital or residential accommodation.

is_fostered.description: Whether the child is fostered by the claimant.

council_pays_for_child.description: Whether the local council pays towards the child's accommodation or maintenance.

works_24_plus_hours.description: Whether the child works 24 or more hours per week in paid employment.

started_apprenticeship_in_england.description: Whether the child has started an apprenticeship in England.

receives_qualifying_benefits.description: Whether the child receives qualifying benefits in their own right, such as Universal Credit or Employment and Support Allowance.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Hello! I'd be happy to help you determine if you're eligible for Child Benefit. 

To get started, I need to gather some information about your circumstances. Let me begin with a basic question:

**How many children do you have that you're enquiring about, and what are their names?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text:
Hello! Yes, I'm interested in claiming Child Benefit and want to check if I'm eligible.

I have one child - Alex. He's 8 years old and lives at home with me.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for that information! It's helpful to know about Alex.

To assess your eligibility for Child Benefit, I need to understand your living situation and responsibilities a bit better.

**Are you currently living in the UK?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, I live in the UK - we're based in Manchester.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Great, thank you for confirming that. Living in the UK is an important requirement.

Now, to clarify your responsibility for Alex:

**Are you the person who primarily looks after Alex day-to-day, and does Alex live with you?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, that's right - Alex lives at home with me and I look after him.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Excellent. That's very helpful to know.

Now I need to check a few more details about your circumstances to ensure there are no other factors that might affect your eligibility.

**Do you have settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme, pre-settled status, or are you a British citizen? (Or if neither of these apply, do you have another right to reside in the UK?)**

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Perfect, thank you for confirming that. Being a British citizen means you have the right to reside in the UK.

Let me ask one more important question to complete the assessment:

**Is Alex currently in any of the following situations: hospital, care arranged by the local council, or residential accommodation arranged by the local council?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: No, none of those situations apply. Alex is just at home with me, living a normal life - going to school and all that.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Wonderful, thank you for confirming that. I now have all the information I need to assess your eligibility.

Based on what you've told me:
- You're a British citizen living in the UK
- Alex is 8 years old and lives with you
- You look after Alex day-to-day
- Alex is not in hospital or any form of council-arranged care

You meet all the eligibility criteria for Child Benefit for Alex.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
**You are eligible to claim Child Benefit for Alex!**

You can now proceed to make a claim. If you have any questions about the next steps or need any further information, feel free to ask.
